title: Sequential launch breaks Lyon both-side stop for early-id motorcycles
description:
PATCH-94 implemented EGKT08 self-stop; resolved 8/75 max-steps cases on rocker-arm. The remaining 67 motorcycles do NOT geometrically self-cross — they simply never satisfy Lyon section 3 both-side alpha-bound stop because in our SEQUENTIAL launch order they have no prior traces to crash INTO. Lyon section 3 cites EGKT08 which specifies parallel/time-stepped propagation: 'in a sequence of time steps, move each particle along the edge.' EGKT08 section 7 line 386: 'the simultaneous movement of the particles is important in making the motorcycle graph canonical but NOT in generating a correct partition' — so non-simultaneous can produce valid partitions, but only if every trace stops. Implementation choice: (A) Two-pass — Pass 1 trace all motorcycles to natural end without applying Lyon stop, then Pass 2 retrace each motorcycle using all Pass 1 traces as walls and apply Lyon stop. Smaller delta from current code. (B) True parallel — priority queue ordered by next-event time per Eppstein canonical. Bigger refactor but most paper-faithful. Recommend (A) first.

UPDATE 2026-05-01: Round-robin (Option B) implemented. EGKT08-faithful step-locked parallel propagation: each motorcycle takes one triangle-step per round, all motorcycles see cumulative state from prior rounds + earlier motorcycles in this round.

RESULTS on rocker-arm at alpha=15:
- proper-Lyon-stop: 47 -> 75 (motorcycles satisfying Lyon both-side alpha-bound)
- abort-max-steps: 73 -> 53 (down from sequential failure mode)
- self-stop: 8 -> 0 (round-robin lets motorcycles stop via Lyon stop before self-crashing)
- visible T-junctions: 20 -> 22
- traces: 128, crashes: 1383 (was 3519 with sequential — fewer crashes because motorcycles stop sooner)
- arcs: 1511 (was 2753; paper 2742) — round-robin produces ~half-length traces
- P merged: 178 -> 36 (over-collapse from shorter traces)
- tMCG: 14s -> 13s (similar)
- Quadlayout regression green (91/91)

Round-robin is correct EGKT08 behavior. The 53 still-MAX_STEPS motorcycles are likely cases where this surface, with our cross-field input (32 vs paper 36 sing), genuinely cannot satisfy Lyon both-side alpha-bound stop within MAX_STEPS rounds. Lyon paper inputs were tighter — more singularities means more crash opportunities.

REMAINING GAPS (separate tickets):
- Priority-queue true parallel (PATCH-96) — would resolve any remaining sequential-within-round bias
- Investigate why traces are shorter than paper (PATCH-97) — could be cross-field quality or alpha computation
- Address P merged over-collapse (PATCH-98) — collapse threshold needs re-tuning for new q distribution

PATCH-95 STATUS: round-robin shipped. Remaining MAX_STEPS cases tracked separately.
definition-of-done: Every motorcycle terminates via Lyon section 3 stop, EGKT08 self-stop, or boundary on rocker-arm alpha=15. abort-max-steps drops to under 5/128. tMCG returns to under 200ms range.
testing-plan: Implement either two-pass (Pass 1 free-trace + Pass 2 retrace with full walls) or priority-queue parallel propagation. Re-run rocker-arm and verify abort-max-steps drops, tMCG drops, downstream metrics improve toward Lyon Table 1.
